title: Afshan Pattern floral carpet (dark blue ground), late 18th century, Khanates Period, Azerbaijan
notes: Afshan Pattern floral carpet (dark blue ground), late 18th century, Khanates Period, Azerbaijan. Türk ve İslam Eserleri Museum, Istanbul. inv. no 832 (1-553) from the Evkaf Depot, Istanbul, Turkey. 270 x 617 cm. published Serare Yetkin's "Early Caucasian carpets in Turkey", plate 79. Rows of cartouche-rosettes alternate with rows of stars, linked by a white curving branch.
